answer: Admission control lets copper fold keys with the same audited controller into one operator, while thread records its admitted heads and spent attesters. For head \(k\), meadow gathers \(k^2\) signatures across independently owned branches, using no owner twice for that operator. Head one costs one unrelated owner; ten cost 385 distinct-owner signatures, and head ten needs 100 fresh owners. Reuse and splitting are invalid, so expansion means bribing ever more unrelated owners; another operator’s debut still costs one.
